scope: two frozen motifs transferred to a disjoint region of the same categorical snapshot
fit: use the exact training dictionary gate against the one-entry candidate and all five baselines; freeze both admitted patterns in training order; fit Huffman on the same training prefix
test: score the two-entry dictionary, its first entry alone, and frozen Huffman on the same held-out prefix after a guard; charge each model once; retain signed gains and zero occurrences
placements: place the first frozen pattern leftmost and disjoint; place the second only within remaining contiguous intervals; each held-out count encodes one plus the number of occurrences
controls: compare two trained arrangements with a test using only the first arrangement at identical label counts; preserve guard and tail isolation, relabeling, and exact decoder round trips
limits: one within-snapshot split with at most 4096 training and 4096 test symbols; engineering fixtures only
